schema.$comment: Store contract 1.3 / wrapper protocol 1.1 = store 1.2 / protocol 1.0 plus pre-implementation amendment CA-01 (2026-10-23, identifiers retained) plus amendment CA-02 (2026-10-24, versioned by owner decision Q-03). See 05_Database_Data_Schema.md sections 22-23 and 19 (records under 1.2/1.0 are not valid 1.3/1.1 records).

DescendantCleanup.$comment: Supervisor action against members of the tool's process group that remained after the direct child exited or was terminated. Does not cover descendants that left the group/session.

RelativePath.description: Repository-relative forward-slash path. Runtime rejects absolute, drive, dot-dot, NUL and escaping paths.

StreamRecord.$comment: Per-stream reader outcome. bytes_consumed = bytes read by the supervisor; bytes_retained = bytes kept in memory for parsing/evidence. Child-generated bytes beyond what was consumed are unknown. not_applicable = no reader existed (e.g. spawn failure); counts are then null.

TerminationPolicy.$comment: Declarative only. Timeout and cancellation are enforced out-of-band by the core process supervisor; this record does not itself stop a running process.

TerminationRecord.$comment: reason is the primary supervisor trigger and is never overwritten by later descendant cleanup; descendant_cleanup records that action separately. 'descendant_cleanup' as reason means the child exited on its own and cleanup was the only supervisor action. process_tree_exited is null when undeterminable.
